headline: Bitcoin holds $61K on soft jobs data as XRP jumps 3.8% and Hyperliquid leads the top 15
summary: A US Independence Day session saw crypto markets find steady footing after recent turbulence. Soft jobs data eased fears of further Federal Reserve rate hikes, helping Bitcoin hold above $61,000 and giving the broader market room to recover. XRP was the standout in the top 15, rising 3.8%, while Hyperliquid gained 5.3% — both outpacing Bitcoin's 1.2% rise. The Fear & Greed index sits at 22, firmly in 'Extreme Fear' territory, suggesting the market's mood remains cautious despite today's green session.

winners.name: LAB
winners.catalyst: LAB surged 29.46% with no specific catalyst identified — the move appears to be driven by thin liquidity rather than a named event or announcement.

losers.name: MemeCore
losers.catalyst: MemeCore dropped 10.78% as negative sentiment weighed on the memecoin segment, with no specific on-chain event or announcement identified as the trigger.

whyItMoved:
The main driver today was a softer-than-expected US jobs report, which reduced pressure on the Federal Reserve to keep rates elevated. Lower rate expectations tend to benefit risk assets — crypto included — and Bitcoin's ability to hold above $61,000 through a holiday-shortened session was read as a constructive sign after weeks of selling pressure.

XRP was the clearest beneficiary in the top 15, rising 3.81% to $1.14. Analysts at CoinDesk noted that a record proportion of XRP holders are currently sitting on unrealized losses — a condition that has historically preceded recoveries, as it reduces the pool of holders likely to sell into strength. That data point drew fresh attention to XRP today. Hyperliquid gained 5.28% to $71.22 with no specific catalyst identified — the move appears technical, consistent with a broader altcoin recovery on light holiday volume.

Zcash added 2.90% to $460.81, likely reflecting anticipation around the approaching Ironwood upgrade, which developers are positioning as a confidence-rebuilding milestone after a sharp price decline earlier this year.

The Fear & Greed index reading of 22 — deep in 'Extreme Fear' — is worth noting as context. Today's green session happened against a backdrop of still-cautious sentiment, not euphoria. Separately, analysts flagged that Bitcoin's next major leg higher may require roughly $1 trillion in fresh capital inflows, a reminder of how much buying pressure would be needed to sustain a significant rally from current levels.
worthKnowing: Bitcoin whale wallets accumulated $16.7 billion worth of BTC over two weeks even as Bitcoin ETFs recorded a record $4 billion in outflows — a split between large holders buying and fund investors selling.
The Zcash Ironwood upgrade is nearing completion; developers say it is designed to restore confidence following a significant ZEC price decline.
Analysts estimate Bitcoin would need approximately $1 trillion in new capital to fuel its next major parabolic run, based on current market structure.
